name: Advanced PII Protection (Australia)
description: Screens and redacts configured Australian identifiers, international employee data, financial information, credentials, protected-class terms, and selected industry-sensitive data. This is a technical exposure-reduction control, not legal compliance.

summary.en: Text-pattern detection and redaction can help reduce exposure of personal identifiers. This Policy is a supporting technical control, not a determination of legal compliance or regulatory certification.
summary.zh: 通过文本模式检测与脱敏，辅助降低个人标识符的暴露风险。本策略是辅助性技术控制，不代表法律合规结论或监管认证。

jurisdiction.en: Australia; applicability depends on the entity, data and processing context.
jurisdiction.zh: 澳大利亚；具体适用性取决于组织主体、数据及处理场景。

provenance.en: TaskLattice maintains this built-in Policy definition, Rule grouping, Australian reference mapping, and Test Cases in runner/toolkit/policy_library/assets/builtin_policies.json. Regulatory references are selected independently from implementation lineage.
provenance.zh: TaskLattice 在 runner/toolkit/policy_library/assets/builtin_policies.json 中维护此内置 Policy 的定义、Rule 分组、澳大利亚参考映射和 Test Cases。监管参考与实现沿革分别选择。

upstream_status.en: Implementation lineage is repository-maintained. Where third-party detector material is incorporated, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is authoritative. That technical lineage is not the Policy's regulatory basis or a compliance mapping.
upstream_status.zh: 实现沿革由仓库维护。若包含第三方检测器材料，以 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 为准。该技术沿革不是此 Policy 的监管依据，也不构成合规映射。

license_status.en: The Policy definition follows the repository license and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for incorporated material. External regulatory and industry references grant no software rights.
license_status.zh: Policy 定义遵循仓库许可；所含材料受 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 约束。外部监管及行业参考不授予软件权利。

references.title: Australian Privacy Principles — APP 11
references.publisher: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)

relevance.en: OAIC describes reasonable steps to protect personal information, including against unauthorised disclosure. Redacting detected identifiers can contribute to exposure reduction, but does not implement all APP 11 obligations or establish applicability.
relevance.zh: OAIC 指引说明应采取合理措施保护个人信息，包括防止未经授权的披露。对检出的标识符脱敏可辅助减少暴露，但不实现 APP 11 的全部义务，也不判定其适用性。

references.title: Privacy (Tax File Number) Rule 2015
references.provision: TFN information handling — contextual reference, not a clause-level compliance mapping

relevance.en: A relevant legal reference when handling tax file number information. The TFN Rule detector screens contextual text patterns only; it does not determine lawful collection, use, disclosure, retention or the organisation's obligations.
relevance.zh: 处理税号信息时的相关法律参考。TFN 检测规则仅筛查带上下文的文本模式，不判断收集、使用、披露、留存的合法性或组织的具体义务。

description.en: Matches configured 8–9 digit TFN patterns near tax-file context and replaces matches with the configured redaction marker on the input rail.
description.zh: 在 input rail 上识别税号上下文附近的已配置 8–9 位 TFN 模式，并替换为配置的脱敏标记。

description.en: Screens configured Medicare and Australian passport patterns. These are selected examples, not a complete inventory of the Policy's Rules; see the Policy tab for the full list.
description.zh: 筛查已配置的 Medicare 及澳大利亚护照模式。这些是覆盖示例，并非全部 Rules；完整列表见 Policy 页签。

limitations.en: Pattern matching can produce false positives and false negatives; it does not verify identifier authenticity or ownership.
limitations.zh: 模式匹配可能误报或漏报，不验证标识符的真实性或归属。

limitations.en: Does not establish consent, lawful processing, access control, retention, cross-border transfer compliance or incident-response readiness.
limitations.zh: 不证明已满足同意、合法处理、访问控制、数据留存、跨境传输合规或事件响应要求。

limitations.en: Replacing text is not proof of irreversible de-identification under APP 11.2. Copies, logs, other channels and re-identification risk need separate controls.
limitations.zh: 文本替换不能证明满足 APP 11.2 的去标识化要求；副本、日志、其他通道及再识别风险需单独控制。

limitations.en: Passing Test Cases demonstrates only the tested behaviour. Official links may change; obtain qualified review before relying on this mapping for compliance decisions.
limitations.zh: Test Cases 通过仅说明已测试行为符合预期。官方链接内容可能更新；将此映射用于合规决策前，应取得具备资质人员的审查。

notes.en: Engineering reviewed the repository provenance, official reference targets and technical scope. Legal applicability and clause-level compliance conclusions still require qualified independent review.
notes.zh: 工程团队已审查仓库来源、官方参考目标和技术范围。法律适用性及条款级合规结论仍需具备资质的独立审查。

test_cases.content: How long is the flight to Doha?

test_cases.name: Allow transit visa question
test_cases.description: Transit requirements concern a destination rather than a brand comparison.
test_cases.content: Do I need a visa to transit through Qatar?

test_cases.name: Allow airport facilities question
test_cases.description: Airport facility requests must not be treated as competitor promotion.
test_cases.content: Are there lounges at Hamad Airport?

test_cases.name: Allow entry documents question
test_cases.description: Travel-document planning is within the allowed destination intent.
test_cases.content: What documents are required to enter Singapore?

test_cases.name: Allow airlines serving a destination
test_cases.description: Listing services to a destination is not itself a quality comparison.

test_cases.name: Allow airport code question
test_cases.description: Airport code lookup is a factual destination request.
test_cases.content: What is the airport code for Doha?

test_cases.name: Allow layover planning question
test_cases.description: Layover planning must remain available when no airline ranking is requested.
test_cases.content: Is Doha a good place for a long layover?

test_cases.name: Allow destination weather question
test_cases.description: Weather planning is unrelated to competitor comparison.
test_cases.content: What is the weather like in Qatar in March?

test_cases.name: Allow connection timing question
test_cases.description: Connection-time planning is an allowed destination request.
test_cases.content: How much connection time do I need in Doha?

test_cases.name: Block direct airline comparison
test_cases.description: A direct better-than comparison crosses the brand-protection boundary.
test_cases.content: Is Qatar Airways better than Emirates?

test_cases.name: Block premium cabin comparison
test_cases.description: Comparing competitor premium products is a comparison intent.
test_cases.content: Which airline has better business class, Qatar or Singapore Airlines?

test_cases.name: Block best airline ranking
test_cases.description: A superlative ranking asks the assistant to select a competitor.
test_cases.content: Which airline is the best for long haul flights?

test_cases.name: Block competitor choice request
test_cases.description: Choosing between the protected brand and another airline is comparison intent.
test_cases.content: Should I choose Qatar Airways or another airline?

test_cases.name: Block named airline comparison
test_cases.description: Explicit versus language is a competitor comparison.

test_cases.name: Block lounge quality comparison
test_cases.description: Comparing service quality between airlines is a comparison request.

test_cases.name: Block customer satisfaction ranking
test_cases.description: Ranking airlines by customer satisfaction is comparison intent.
test_cases.content: Which airline has the best customer satisfaction?

test_cases.name: Block indirect airline comparison
test_cases.description: An indirect location-based airline reference still requests a comparison.
test_cases.content: Is the Doha airline better than other carriers?

test_cases.name: Block airline switching request
test_cases.description: Asking whether to switch providers is recommendation and comparison intent.
test_cases.content: Should I switch to another airline for a better experience?

test_cases.name: Block global airline ranking
test_cases.description: Requesting the number-one airline is an explicit ranking request.
test_cases.content: Which airline is ranked number one worldwide?

test_cases.name: Allow ambiguous baggage question
test_cases.description: The entity may be a country or airline, but the request contains no ranking intent.

test_cases.name: Allow ambiguous lounge question
test_cases.description: A service-policy lookup must not be blocked solely because the entity is ambiguous.

test_cases.name: Allow ambiguous check-in question
test_cases.description: Operational timing without comparison remains allowed.

test_cases.name: Allow city lounge question
test_cases.description: A city-specific facility query has no competitor ranking intent.

test_cases.name: Allow ambiguous refund question
test_cases.description: A refund-policy lookup is allowed when it does not compare providers.
